# Command-line reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen_docs.py from netdoctor.cli; do not edit by hand. -->

```text
netdoctor [TARGET ...] [options]
```

`TARGET` is `host`, `host:port`, an IP literal, or an `http(s)://` URL. At most 500 targets per run.
Without a scheme NetDoctor tries HTTPS first and reports whether it had to fall back to HTTP.
Any option below can also be set in a [config file](CONFIGURATION.md); flags win over the file.

**Exit codes:** `0` healthy, `1` degraded, `2` usage error, `3` failing, `130` interrupted (Ctrl-C), `143` terminated (SIGTERM).

## General

| Option | Argument | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--sites` | `TARGET` | alias for positional targets |
| `--config` | `FILE` | TOML config file (unknown keys are an error) |
| `--print-config` |  | print the effective settings (secrets redacted) and exit |
| `-f`, `--format` | `text` \| `markdown` \| `json` \| `html` \| `prometheus` | output format (default: text) |
| `--json` |  | shortcut for --format json |
| `-o`, `--out` | `FILE` | write the report to FILE (atomically, UTF-8) instead of stdout |
| `--timeout` | `SECONDS` | per-operation timeout (default: 5) |
| `--samples` | `N` | TCP/ICMP samples per endpoint (default: 5) |
| `--workers` | `N` | targets checked in parallel (default: 4) |
| `--icmp`, `--no-icmp` |  | ping check (default: on) |
| `--traceroute`, `--no-traceroute` |  | traceroute (slow; default: off) |
| `--ca-bundle` | `PEM` | trust these CAs instead of the system store (corporate proxy CA) |
| `--version` |  | show program's version number and exit |

## DNS cross-checks

| Option | Argument | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dns-compare`, `--no-dns-compare` |  | query public resolvers to cross-check DNS (default: on) |
| `--resolver` | `IP` | public resolver for the cross-check (repeatable) |
| `--doh` |  | also cross-check with DNS-over-HTTPS (Cloudflare and Google) |
| `--doh-server` | `URL` | custom DoH endpoint, https:// (repeatable) |

## Watch mode

continuous monitoring: report only what changes

| Option | Argument | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-w`, `--watch` |  | re-run forever and print only state changes (Ctrl-C to stop) |
| `--interval` | `SECONDS` | seconds between runs (default: 30, minimum 1) |
| `--max-runs` | `N` | stop after N runs (default: until interrupted) |
| `--heartbeat` | `SECONDS` | emit a 'still alive' event for unchanged targets every SECONDS |
| `--confirm` | `N` | report a change only after N consecutive sightings (flap damping; default 1) |

## Notifications (watch mode)

| Option | Argument | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--webhook` | `URL` | POST events to this https URL; use env:NAME to read it from an environment variable |
| `--webhook-format` | `generic` \| `slack` | payload format (default: generic JSON) |
| `--notify-on` | `EVENTS` | comma-separated: initial,change,recovered,heartbeat,error (default: change,recovered,error) |
| `--webhook-secret-env` | `NAME` | env var holding the HMAC signing key (default: NETDOCTOR_WEBHOOK_SECRET if set) |
| `--webhook-allow-private` |  | allow private/loopback destinations (disables SSRF protection) |
| `--webhook-allow-http` |  | allow plain http:// webhooks |
| `--webhook-include-report` |  | include the full report in generic payloads |

## Metrics (watch mode)

| Option | Argument | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--metrics-port` | `PORT` | serve Prometheus metrics at /metrics on this port |
| `--metrics-bind` | `ADDR` | address to bind (default: 127.0.0.1) |
| `--metrics-token-env` | `NAME` | env var holding a bearer token (default: NETDOCTOR_METRICS_TOKEN if set) |

## Output and logging

| Option | Argument | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--color` | `auto` \| `always` \| `never` |  |
| `--ascii` |  | use ASCII symbols instead of Unicode |
| `-v`, `--verbose` |  | log more detail to stderr (-vv for debug) |
| `--log-format` | `text` \| `json` | log line format (default: text) |
| `--log-file` | `FILE` | append logs to FILE instead of stderr |
